question: How many flights are currently in the system?
paraphrase: Give the total number of flights are currently in the system?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights;

question: Which airline had the highest cancellation rate?
paraphrase: Identify which airline had the highest cancellation rate?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN f.status='Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS cancel_rate FROM flights f JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY cancel_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List all passengers with Platinum frequent flyer status.
paraphrase: Retrieve every passengers with Platinum frequent flyer status.
expected_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, nationality FROM passengers WHERE frequent_flyer_tier = 'Platinum';

question: Which airline transported the highest number of passengers based on confirmed bookings?
paraphrase: What specific airline transported the highest number of passengers based on confirmed bookings?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, COUNT(*) AS passengers_transported FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id WHERE b.booking_status='Confirmed' GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY passengers_transported DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average fare amount by seat class?
paraphrase: Calculate the mean fare amount by seat class?
expected_sql: SELECT seat_class, ROUND(AVG(fare_amount),2) AS avg_fare FROM bookings GROUP BY seat_class ORDER BY avg_fare DESC;

question: How many distinct passengers have flown with SkyBridge Airlines?
paraphrase: Give the total number of distinct passengers have flown with SkyBridge Airlines?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.passenger_id) FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id WHERE al.airline_name='SkyBridge Airlines';

question: Which airports have the most departing flights?
paraphrase: Identify which airports have the most departing flights?
expected_sql: SELECT ap.city, ap.airport_code, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM flights f JOIN airports ap ON f.origin_airport_id=ap.airport_id GROUP BY ap.airport_id ORDER BY departures DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List passengers who have made more than 8 bookings.
paraphrase: Can you show me list passengers who have made more than 8 bookings.?
expected_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS num_bookings FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id GROUP BY p.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY num_bookings DESC;

question: What is the total revenue generated from Business class bookings?
paraphrase: Can you show me what is the total revenue generated from business class bookings??
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(fare_amount),2) AS total_revenue FROM bookings WHERE seat_class='Business' AND booking_status='Confirmed';

question: Which aircraft model is used most frequently across all airlines?
paraphrase: What specific aircraft model is used most frequently across all airlines?
expected_sql: SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS num_aircraft FROM aircraft GROUP BY model ORDER BY num_aircraft DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find flights that were delayed departing from JFK.
paraphrase: Can you show me find flights that were delayed departing from jfk.?
expected_sql: SELECT f.flight_number, f.departure_time, f.status FROM flights f JOIN airports ap ON f.origin_airport_id=ap.airport_id WHERE ap.airport_code='JFK' AND f.status='Delayed';

question: How many bookings have no associated fare amount recorded?
paraphrase: What is the total count of bookings have no associated fare amount recorded?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE fare_amount IS NULL;

question: Which passengers have flown on more than 3 different airlines?
paraphrase: Find which passengers have flown on more than 3 different airlines?
expected_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.airline_id) AS num_airlines FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id GROUP BY p.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.airline_id) > 3;

question: What is the average flight duration in hours for each airline?
paraphrase: Find the average flight duration in hours for each airline?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, ROUND(AVG((julianday(f.arrival_time)-julianday(f.departure_time))*24),2) AS avg_duration_hrs FROM flights f JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY avg_duration_hrs DESC;

question: List the 5 most recent bookings made.
paraphrase: Can you show me list the 5 most recent bookings made.?
expected_sql: SELECT booking_id, passenger_id, booking_date, seat_class FROM bookings ORDER BY booking_date DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which flights had zero confirmed bookings?
paraphrase: Identify which flights had zero confirmed bookings?
expected_sql: SELECT f.flight_id, f.flight_number FROM flights f WHERE f.flight_id NOT IN (SELECT flight_id FROM bookings WHERE booking_status='Confirmed');

question: What is the total number of aircraft owned by each airline?
paraphrase: Can you show me what is the total number of aircraft owned by each airline??
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, COUNT(*) AS num_aircraft FROM aircraft ac JOIN airlines al ON ac.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY num_aircraft DESC;

question: Find passengers who booked flights but whose booking was later cancelled more than once.
paraphrase: Can you show me find passengers who booked flights but whose booking was later cancelled more than once.?
expected_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_count FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id WHERE b.booking_status='Cancelled' GROUP BY p.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY cancelled_count DESC;

question: What percentage of all flights were completed on schedule (status Completed)?
paraphrase: Can you show me what percentage of all flights were completed on schedule (status completed)??
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS completed_pct FROM flights;

question: Which route (origin-destination pair) has the highest number of flights?
paraphrase: Identify which route (origin-destination pair) has the highest number of flights?
expected_sql: SELECT o.airport_code AS origin, d.airport_code AS destination, COUNT(*) AS num_flights FROM flights f JOIN airports o ON f.origin_airport_id=o.airport_id JOIN airports d ON f.destination_airport_id=d.airport_id GROUP BY f.origin_airport_id, f.destination_airport_id ORDER BY num_flights DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many passengers have never made a booking?
paraphrase: Give the total number of passengers have never made a booking?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM passengers WHERE passenger_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT passenger_id FROM bookings);

question: List airlines founded before 1980.
paraphrase: Can you show me list airlines founded before 1980.?
expected_sql: SELECT airline_name, founded_year FROM airlines WHERE founded_year < 1980 ORDER BY founded_year;

question: What is the average fare paid by passengers with Gold status versus those with no status?
paraphrase: Find the average fare paid by passengers with Gold status versus those with no status?
expected_sql: SELECT p.frequent_flyer_tier, ROUND(AVG(b.fare_amount),2) AS avg_fare FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id WHERE p.frequent_flyer_tier IN ('Gold','None') GROUP BY p.frequent_flyer_tier;

question: Which aircraft has flown the most flights?
paraphrase: What specific aircraft has flown the most flights?
expected_sql: SELECT ac.aircraft_id, ac.model, COUNT(*) AS num_flights FROM flights f JOIN aircraft ac ON f.aircraft_id=ac.aircraft_id GROUP BY ac.aircraft_id ORDER BY num_flights DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the total fare revenue collected per month over the last year.
paraphrase: Can you show me find the total fare revenue collected per month over the last year.?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booking_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(fare_amount),2) AS revenue FROM bookings WHERE booking_status='Confirmed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Which passengers have booked both Economy and First class seats?
paraphrase: Identify which passengers have booked both Economy and First class seats?
expected_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM passengers p WHERE p.passenger_id IN (SELECT passenger_id FROM bookings WHERE seat_class='Economy') AND p.passenger_id IN (SELECT passenger_id FROM bookings WHERE seat_class='First');

question: What is the capacity utilization estimate (confirmed bookings vs aircraft capacity) for each flight, top 10 highest?
paraphrase: Can you show me what is the capacity utilization estimate (confirmed bookings vs aircraft capacity) for each flight, top 10 highest??
expected_sql: SELECT f.flight_number, COUNT(b.booking_id) AS confirmed_bookings, ac.capacity, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(b.booking_id)/ac.capacity,2) AS utilization_pct FROM flights f JOIN aircraft ac ON f.aircraft_id=ac.aircraft_id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON f.flight_id=b.flight_id AND b.booking_status='Confirmed' GROUP BY f.flight_id ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which country has the most airlines headquartered there?
paraphrase: What specific country has the most airlines headquartered there?
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS num_airlines FROM airlines GROUP BY country ORDER BY num_airlines DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List flights arriving at Dubai international airport (DXB).
paraphrase: Can you show me list flights arriving at dubai international airport (dxb).?
expected_sql: SELECT f.flight_number, f.arrival_time, f.status FROM flights f JOIN airports ap ON f.destination_airport_id=ap.airport_id WHERE ap.airport_code='DXB';

question: Which passenger has spent the most money on bookings in total?
paraphrase: Identify which passenger has spent the most money on bookings in total?
expected_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, ROUND(SUM(b.fare_amount),2) AS total_spent FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id WHERE b.booking_status='Confirmed' GROUP BY p.passenger_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many aircraft were manufactured after 2018?
paraphrase: What is the total count of aircraft were manufactured after 2018?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE manufacture_year > 2018;

question: Find airlines whose average booking fare exceeds the overall average fare across all airlines.
paraphrase: Can you show me find airlines whose average booking fare exceeds the overall average fare across all airlines.?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, ROUND(AVG(b.fare_amount),2) AS avg_fare FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id HAVING AVG(b.fare_amount) > (SELECT AVG(fare_amount) FROM bookings);

question: What is the busiest month for flight departures?
paraphrase: Can you show me what is the busiest month for flight departures??
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', departure_time) AS month, COUNT(*) AS num_departures FROM flights GROUP BY month ORDER BY num_departures DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List passengers born before 1960.
paraphrase: Can you show me list passengers born before 1960.?
expected_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM passengers WHERE birth_date < '1960-01-01';

question: Which flights have a duration longer than 10 hours?
paraphrase: Find which flights have a duration longer than 10 hours?
expected_sql: SELECT flight_number, departure_time, arrival_time, ROUND((julianday(arrival_time)-julianday(departure_time))*24,2) AS duration_hrs FROM flights WHERE (julianday(arrival_time)-julianday(departure_time))*24 > 10 ORDER BY duration_hrs DESC;

question: How many waitlisted bookings currently exist per airline?
paraphrase: Can you tell me how many waitlisted bookings currently exist per airline?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, COUNT(*) AS waitlisted FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id WHERE b.booking_status='Waitlisted' GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY waitlisted DESC;

question: Which nationality of passengers books the most Business class seats?
paraphrase: What specific nationality of passengers books the most Business class seats?
expected_sql: SELECT p.nationality, COUNT(*) AS business_bookings FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id WHERE b.seat_class='Business' GROUP BY p.nationality ORDER BY business_bookings DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the second-highest fare ever paid for a single booking.
paraphrase: Can you show me find the second-highest fare ever paid for a single booking.?
expected_sql: SELECT fare_amount FROM bookings ORDER BY fare_amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

question: How many distinct routes does each airline operate?
paraphrase: Can you tell me how many distinct routes does each airline operate?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.origin_airport_id || '-' || f.destination_airport_id) AS distinct_routes FROM flights f JOIN airlines al ON f.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY distinct_routes DESC;

question: Which flights are scheduled but originate from an airport with fewer than 20 total flights?
paraphrase: Find which flights are scheduled but originate from an airport with fewer than 20 total flights?
expected_sql: SELECT f.flight_number, f.origin_airport_id FROM flights f WHERE f.status='Scheduled' AND f.origin_airport_id IN (SELECT origin_airport_id FROM flights GROUP BY origin_airport_id HAVING COUNT(*) < 20);

question: What is the total number of seats (capacity) available across all aircraft owned by each airline?
paraphrase: Can you show me what is the total number of seats (capacity) available across all aircraft owned by each airline??
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, SUM(ac.capacity) AS total_capacity FROM aircraft ac JOIN airlines al ON ac.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY total_capacity DESC;

question: List bookings made on the same day the flight departed (same-day bookings).
paraphrase: Can you show me list bookings made on the same day the flight departed (same-day bookings).?
expected_sql: SELECT b.booking_id, b.booking_date, f.departure_time FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id WHERE date(b.booking_date) = date(f.departure_time) LIMIT 20;

question: Which passengers have a booking with a NULL or missing seat class recorded?
paraphrase: Find which passengers have a booking with a NULL or missing seat class recorded?
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM passengers p JOIN bookings b ON p.passenger_id=b.passenger_id WHERE b.seat_class IS NULL;

question: What is the average passenger age at time of booking, grouped by seat class?
paraphrase: Show average passenger age at time of booking, grouped by seat class?
expected_sql: SELECT b.seat_class, ROUND(AVG((julianday(b.booking_date)-julianday(p.birth_date))/365.25),1) AS avg_age FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id GROUP BY b.seat_class ORDER BY avg_age DESC;

question: Which airline operates the newest fleet on average (by manufacture year)?
paraphrase: Find which airline operates the newest fleet on average (by manufacture year)?
expected_sql: SELECT al.airline_name, ROUND(AVG(ac.manufacture_year),1) AS avg_year FROM aircraft ac JOIN airlines al ON ac.airline_id=al.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id ORDER BY avg_year DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many flights were delayed or cancelled in the last 90 days?
paraphrase: Give the total number of flights were delayed or cancelled in the last 90 days?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE status IN ('Delayed','Cancelled') AND departure_time >= date('now','-90 day');

question: Find the top 3 passengers by number of distinct destination cities visited.
paraphrase: Can you show me find the top 3 passengers by number of distinct destination cities visited.?
expected_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.city) AS distinct_cities FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id=p.passenger_id JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id=f.flight_id JOIN airports ap ON f.destination_airport_id=ap.airport_id WHERE b.booking_status='Confirmed' GROUP BY p.passenger_id ORDER BY distinct_cities DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the total number of bookings in the system?
paraphrase: Can you show me what is the total number of bookings in the system??
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings;

question: Which airports serve as both an origin and destination for more than 50 flights combined?
paraphrase: Find which airports serve as both an origin and destination for more than 50 flights combined?
expected_sql: SELECT ap.airport_code, ap.city, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE origin_airport_id=ap.airport_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE destination_airport_id=ap.airport_id) AS total_traffic FROM airports ap HAVING total_traffic > 50 ORDER BY total_traffic DESC;
